text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
When you have an espressivo trapped inside that cannot find words,
you simply must weave it into a melodia!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Do not be afraid, mio agnellino. We shall start with an adagio.
Fear not, for I shall lead. I will never let you lose your way.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now then, let the needle drop.

Sounds of Earth's violin resonates throughout the area.
—Instantly, goosebumps prickle across my skin.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, holy crap... Isn't she insanely good...?
The tone is so gorgeous! Wow...!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: ............Whoa! I completely lost myself listening to that...!

Passersby stop in their tracks one after another, drawn by Sounds of Earth's violin.
And no wonder. Her playing carried that kind of undeniable power.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Come now! Join me, mio musicista!
Have you forgotten? Today, we play a duo.

Her words remind me of the maracas in my hands.
A duo? Wait, that means...
choice_data_list: Huh?! I'm supposed to join in too?!
Huh?! I'm supposed to join in too?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! The overture has already begun!
It matters not if it is unrefined. Ready yourself as your heart dictates!
I've never performed on the street in my life... The crowd's expectant gazes pierce right into me. There's no escaping this situation.
choice_data_list: (...N-Now that it's come to this, I just have to do it!)

text_block_list.text: *shk-shk, shk-shk*—I give the maracas a timid shake. I try my best to play in a way that won't ruin the performance for the audience.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? That's totally out of sync with the violin.
Is that person really her partner?
choice_data_list: ...! I-I need to do better...!

text_block_list.text:
I can't ruin Sounds of Earth's gorgeous performance.
I have to listen closely to the violin and match her timing!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
............Heheh. A diminuendo armonia.
Is that truly the melodia your heart wishes to play?
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the tempo of the violin slows down.
Even an amateur like me can tell—she's adjusting her pace to match mine.
choice_data_list: Wh... Why are you matching me...?!
Wh... Why are you matching me...?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Did I not say I would lead you?
—La musica will never leave you alone.
From there, she gradually increases the tempo of her playing. As I shake the maracas to keep up, our playing progressively turns into real music—
choice_data_list: (It feels like she's taking me by the hand...)
(It feels like she's taking me by the hand...)

text_block_list.text:
It was like a kind of magic. All I had to do was follow her violin.
Just doing that allowed me to naturally make music.
choice_data_list: (Th-This is actually so much fun...!)

text_block_list.text:
I begin to catch the groove. Strength flows into my hands as I shake the maracas.
I never knew making music with someone could be this thrilling—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Attacca! To heights beyond where mere words can reach!
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah! More...!
Y-Yeah! More...!

text_block_list.text:
Before I realized it, I was completely lost in this jam session.
I keep shaking the maracas to my heart's content. My spirits soar. The melody leaps—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Heheh! Ahahaha!
choice_data_list: Haha... Ahaha!

text_block_list.text: The sound of applause snaps me back to reality. Looking around, I see a dozen or so onlookers clapping enthusiastically for me and Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
That was an amazing performance! So, so incredible!
Please play here again! We'll definitely come watch!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie! Amore!
Did you revel in our sublime armonia?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hold this musica close to your heart as you drift to sleep tonight.
If you do... I'm certain we'll meet again in your dreams.

Her dashing words draw cheers from all around the plaza.
Before I know it, I'm bowing right alongside her to the crowd—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Braviiiiiissimo!!!
What a magnificent session! My very soul trembled!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You've played musica before, haven't you? There's no other explanation!
If that was your first time, you are an extraordinary diamond in the rough!
choice_data_list: Thanks... but you're the one who's amazing.
Thank you... but you're the amazing one here.

text_block_list.text:
She took my clumsy amateur playing, led the way, and turned it into true music.
Even to an untrained ear like mine, her skill was clearly extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie! So you felt my brillante!
Did it help bring that smile back to your face?

Her question suddenly makes me wonder.
Come to think of it, why did she reach out to me in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's quite simple, really. Yesterday, I happened to see you
playing such a terribly doloroso melodia.
choice_data_list: ...? But I wasn't playing any music...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, perhaps you didn't realize it yourself. But you see,
people are always naturally weaving their own melodia.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ritenuto in times of sorrow. Spiritoso in times of joy.
And tempestoso in those moments when your heart is a whirlwind.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I can "hear" it all, plain as day.
It's nothing complicated. All you have to do is listen closely.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Come, let me teach you the secret to feeling the melodia!
Follow me, amico!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Come, let me teach you the secret to feeling the melodia!
Follow me, amica!

Sounds of Earth leads me to a bustling shopping street.
There, she leans in close and whispers right into my ear.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now, feel the melodia... just let your senses guide you.
choice_data_list: Whoa, aren't you a bit close...!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my apologies. It seems I flustered
those lovely ears of yours. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Look over there... You see that performer dancing a magnificent danza?
Listen closely. What do you hear?

I close my eyes and try to listen. ...The squeak of shoes against the pavement.
Heavy, ragged breathing. A voice calling out, "Let's hear some applause!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear it? He is in stretta.
Playing out tension and passion. Truly grazioso, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now, onto the next. What about the man calling out to customers over there?

I look toward the butcher enthusiastically yelling, "Welcome, welcome!"
With a bright smile, he chats up the passersby.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Con spirito! Ah, what a thrilling melodia!
It fills me with joy just listening to it!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now then, what about her? Look, she's skipping, isn't she?

A little girl is walking hand-in-hand with her mother. Tap, tap,
go her little shoes. ...I think I'm starting to understand.
choice_data_list: Um... It sounds kind of exciting and joyful?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì! Precisely!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Do you see now? Every single person is playing their own melodia.
It's an expression of self far richer and deeper than mere emotion!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And when these sounds weave together, what is born is—an ensemble!
The grand musica played by this very street!
choice_data_list: I-I see...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I don't blame you for falling tacet.
Still, I believe in you. I know my message has reached your heart.

To be honest, I'm not sure I fully grasped everything.
But one thing about Sounds of Earth became crystal clear to me.
choice_data_list: You're really good at tuning into people's feelings, aren't you?
You're truly gifted at reading people's emotions, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...! Ahaha!
So that's how you felt my melodia!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how utterly amoroso...!
Say, won't you come watch tomorrow's session?
choice_data_list: A session? Do you have a concert or something?
A session? Is there a concert coming up?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! An exquisite armonia played upon the turf by our angeli—
the Debut Selection Race. I would be thrilled to have you there!

I see, so she calls races "sessions" too.
After how much her music cheered me up today, I have no reason to refuse.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie! You can look forward to it!
I promise you a session that will leave you truly animato!
choice_data_list: Um... what does "animato" mean?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufu. As for that—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: You'll surely understand tomorrow.
